messages:
Dana: Final RN draft is live: https://docs.internal/rn/infer-2-8. Target deploy 2025-02-18 13:45 UTC. Need ops + comms thumbs.
Leo: Reading. Can you confirm the pin for canary?
Dana: Pin: inference:v2.8.0-canary for canary window. Auto-promote to inference:v2.8.0 stable if metrics pass.
Priyanka: Proposed canary config: 6% traffic for 9 hours. I want explicit rollback criteria in RN.
Leo: Suggested criteria: sustained 5xx >=6% over a 7-minute rolling window OR p95 latency >2.2s for 4 consecutive 5m buckets => immediate rollback. Also manual rollback if eval regressions exceed threshold.
Dana: Good. Assign rollback owner: Sam for first 10 hours. Sam: I can take it. If I trigger rollback I'll open #incident-inference and call infra lead.
Sam: Rollback command to include in RN exactly as below:
```
# rollback to last stable tag
infractl rollback --service=inference --to-tag=v2.7.21 --note "canary_alert"
```
Dana: Add runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/rollback-inference and telemetry tag: rn=infer-2.8-canary.
Priyanka: Announce schedule: internal alert in #eng-releases and #oncall at T-8m, deploybot scheduled run at 13:45 UTC, customer-facing update 2.5 hours after canary success. Mark as embargoed until post-canary.
Leo: Microcopy for PMs: "No feature changes. Expected latency improvement ~4-9% on responses >600 tokens." Suggest we quantify like that.
Sam: I'll paste a minimal post-rollback verification checklist into the runbook after deploy. Also will paste the exact rollback steps into RN ops snippet.
deploybot: Scheduled deploy: 2025-02-18T13:45:00Z. Canary: 6% traffic for 9h. Fallback target: v2.7.21.
Dana: Can we add monitoring owners in RN (dashboards + synthetic checks)? Add Leo for latency, Priyanka for quality evals.
Leo: I'll watch latency dashboards at launch. Priyanka: I'll run the eval set after 1h and again at end of canary.
Dana: OK final checklist: RN updated with pin, canary config, thresholds, rollback command, runbook link, telemetry tag, owners, and announce cadence. Anyone object to internal alert T-8m?
Priyanka: No objections. Posting internal alert on my mark.
Sam: Standing by. If I roll back I'll use the command above and run post-rollback checks.
Dana: Thanks all 44d I'll pin this thread to the RN folder and send the internal alert at T-8m.
deploybot: Reminder: scheduled in 9 minutes for thread 1809998888.
